description: Lists S3 buckets and details about those buckets.

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: bucket_facts
parameters.description: Retrieve requested S3 bucket detailed information. Each bucket_X option executes one API call, hence many options being set to true will cause slower module execution. You can limit buckets by using the name or name_filter option.

parameters.name: bucket_accelerate_configuration
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 accelerate configuration. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_acl
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket ACLs. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_cors
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket CORS configuration. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_encryption
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket encryption. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_lifecycle_configuration
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket lifecycle configuration. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_location
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket location. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_logging
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket logging. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_notification_configuration
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket notification configuration. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_ownership_controls
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 ownership controls. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_policy
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket policy. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_policy_status
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket policy status. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_replication
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket replication. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_request_payment
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket request payment. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_tagging
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket tagging. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_versioning
parameters.description: Retrieve the versioning state of a bucket. To retrieve the versioning state of a bucket, you must be the bucket owner. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: bucket_website
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket website. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: public_access_block
parameters.description: Retrieve S3 bucket public access block. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of bucket to query. Default: ""

parameters.name: name_filter
parameters.description: Limits buckets to only buckets who’s name contain the string in name_filter. Default: ""

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: transform_location
parameters.description: S3 bucket location for default us-east-1 is normally reported as null. Setting this option to true will return us-east-1 instead. Affects only queries with bucket_facts=true and bucket_facts.bucket_location=true. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
# Note: These examples do not set authentication details, see the AWS Guide for details.

# Note: Only AWS S3 is currently supported

# Lists all S3 buckets
- amazon.aws.s3_bucket_info:
  register: result

# Retrieve detailed bucket information
- amazon.aws.s3_bucket_info:
    # Show only buckets with name matching
    name_filter: your.testing
    # Choose facts to retrieve
    bucket_facts:
      # bucket_accelerate_configuration: true
      bucket_acl: true
      bucket_cors: true
      bucket_encryption: true
      # bucket_lifecycle_configuration: true
      bucket_location: true
      # bucket_logging: true
      # bucket_notification_configuration: true
      # bucket_ownership_controls: true
      # bucket_policy: true
      # bucket_policy_status: true
      # bucket_replication: true
      # bucket_request_payment: true
      # bucket_tagging: true
      # bucket_website: true
      # public_access_block: true
    transform_location: true
    register: result

# Print out result
- name: List buckets
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ result['buckets'] }}"

return_values.name: buckets
return_values.description: A list of S3 buckets. Returned: always

return_values.name: bucket_accelerate_configuration
return_values.description: The accelerate configuration of the bucket. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_accelerate_configuration=true. Sample: {"RequestCharged": "requester", "Status": "Enabled"}

return_values.name: bucket_acl
return_values.description: Bucket ACL configuration. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_acl=true.

return_values.name: Grants
return_values.description: List of ACL grants. Returned: success Sample: [{"Grantee": {"DisplayName": "abc-aws-root+721234567890", "ID": "1234567890cbc0f1234567890f1234567890c123456789012123456789091234", "Type": "CanonicalUser"}, "Permission": "FULL_CONTROL"}]

return_values.name: Grantee
return_values.description: The person being granted permissions. Returned: success

return_values.name: DisplayName
return_values.description: Screen name of the grantee. Returned: success

return_values.name: ID
return_values.description: The canonical user ID of the grantee. Returned: success

return_values.name: Type
return_values.description: Type of grantee. Returned: success

return_values.name: Permission
return_values.description: Specifies the permission given to the grantee. Returned: success

return_values.name: Owner
return_values.description: Bucket owner information. Returned: success Sample: {"DisplayName": "abc-aws-root+721234567890", "ID": "1234567890cbc0f1234567890f1234567890c123456789012123456789091234"}

return_values.name: bucket_cors
return_values.description: Bucket CORS configuration. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_cors=true

return_values.name: CORSRules
return_values.description: Bucket CORS configuration. Returned: When CORS rules are defined for the bucket Sample: []

return_values.name: bucket_encryption
return_values.description: Bucket encryption configuration. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_encryption=true. Sample: {"ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration": {"Rules": [{"ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault": {"SSEAlgorithm": "AES256"}, "BucketKeyEnabled": true}]}}

return_values.name: ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
return_values.description: ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration configuration. Returned: when encryption is enabled on the bucket.

return_values.name: Rules
return_values.description: List of applied encryptio rules. Returned: when encryption is enabled on the bucket.

return_values.name: ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault
return_values.description: Specifies the default server-side encryption to apply to new objects in the bucket. Returned: success

return_values.name: KMSMasterKeyID
return_values.description: Amazon Web Services Key Management Service (KMS) customer Amazon Web Services KMS key ID to use for the default encryption. Returned: success

return_values.name: SSEAlgorithm
return_values.description: Server-side encryption algorithm to use for the default encryption. Returned: success

return_values.name: BucketKeyEnabled
return_values.description: Specifies whether Amazon S3 should use an S3 Bucket Key with server-side encryption using KMS (SSE-KMS) for new objects in the bucket. Returned: success

return_values.name: bucket_lifecycle_configuration
return_values.description: Bucket lifecycle configuration settings. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_lifecycle_configuration=true.

return_values.name: bucket_location
return_values.description: Bucket location. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_location=true. Sample: {"LocationConstraint": "us-east-1"}

return_values.name: LocationConstraint
return_values.description: AWS region. Returned: always

return_values.name: bucket_logging
return_values.description: Server access logging configuration. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_logging=true.

return_values.name: LoggingEnabled
return_values.description: Server access logging configuration. Returned: when server access logging is defined for the bucket.

return_values.name: TargetBucket
return_values.description: Target bucket name. Returned: always Sample: "logging-bucket-name"

return_values.name: TargetPrefix
return_values.description: Prefix in target bucket. Returned: always Sample: ""

return_values.name: bucket_name_filter
return_values.description: String used to limit buckets. See name_filter. Returned: when name_filter is defined Sample: "filter-by-this-string"

return_values.name: bucket_notification_configuration
return_values.description: Bucket notification settings. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_notification_configuration=true.

return_values.name: TopicConfigurations
return_values.description: List of notification events configurations. Returned: when at least one notification is configured. Sample: [{"Events": ["s3:ObjectCreated:Copy"], "Filter": {"Key": {"FilterRules": [{"Name": "Prefix", "Value": "test/"}]}}, "Id": "topic-config-dev001", "TopicArn": "arn:aws:sns:us-west-1:721234567890:sns-dev001-topic"}]

return_values.name: bucket_ownership_controls
return_values.description: Preffered object ownership settings. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_ownership_controls=true Sample: {"OwnershipControls": {"Rules": [{"ObjectOwnership": "BucketOwnerEnforced"}]}}

return_values.name: OwnershipControls
return_values.description: Object ownership settings. Returned: when ownership controls are defined for the bucket.

return_values.name: bucket_policy
return_values.description: Bucket policy contents. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_policy=true. Sample: "{\"Version\":\"2012-10-17\",\"Statement\":[{\"Sid\":\"AddCannedAcl\",\"Effect\":\"Allow\",..}}]}"

return_values.name: bucket_policy_status
return_values.description: Status of bucket policy. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_policy_status=true.

return_values.name: PolicyStatus
return_values.description: Status of bucket policy. Returned: when bucket policy is present.

return_values.name: IsPublic
return_values.description: Report bucket policy public status. Returned: when bucket policy is present. Sample: true

return_values.name: bucket_replication
return_values.description: Replication configuration settings. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_replication=true.

return_values.name: Role
return_values.description: IAM role used for replication. Returned: when replication rule is defined. Sample: "arn:aws:iam::123:role/example-role"

return_values.name: bucket_request_payment
return_values.description: Requester pays setting. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_request_payment=true Sample: {"Payer": "BucketOwner"}

return_values.name: Payer
return_values.description: Current payer. Returned: always

return_values.name: bucket_tagging
return_values.description: Bucket tags. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_tagging=true. Sample: {"Tag1": "Value1", "Tag2": "Value2"}

return_values.name: bucket_versioning
return_values.description: The versioning state of the bucket. This will also specify whether MFA delete is enabled in the bucket versioning configuration. if only the bucket has been configured with MFA delete. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_versioning=true. Sample: {"Status": "Enabled"}

return_values.name: bucket_website
return_values.description: Static website hosting. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.bucket_website=true.

return_values.name: ErrorDocument
return_values.description: Object serving as HTTP error page. Returned: when static website hosting is enabled. Sample: {"Key": "error.html"}

return_values.name: IndexDocument
return_values.description: Object serving as HTTP index page. Returned: when static website hosting is enabled. Sample: {"Suffix": "error.html"}

return_values.name: RedirectAllRequestsTo
return_values.description: Website redict settings. Returned: when redirect requests is configured.

return_values.name: HostName
return_values.description: Hostname to redirect. Returned: always Sample: "www.example.com"

return_values.name: Protocol
return_values.description: Protocol used for redirect. Returned: always Sample: "https"

return_values.name: creation_date
return_values.description: Bucket creation date timestamp. Returned: always Sample: "2021-01-21T12:44:10+00:00"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Bucket name. Returned: always Sample: "a-testing-bucket-name"

return_values.name: public_access_block
return_values.description: Bucket public access block configuration. Returned: when bucket_facts=true and buckets.public_access_block=true. Sample: {"PublicAccessBlockConfiguration": {"BlockPublicAcls": true, "BlockPublicPolicy": true, "IgnorePublicAcls": true, "RestrictPublicBuckets": true}}

return_values.name: PublicAccessBlockConfiguration
return_values.description: PublicAccessBlockConfiguration data. Returned: when PublicAccessBlockConfiguration is defined for the bucket

return_values.name: BlockPublicAcls
return_values.description: BlockPublicAcls setting value. Returned: success

return_values.name: BlockPublicPolicy
return_values.description: BlockPublicPolicy setting value. Returned: success

return_values.name: IgnorePublicAcls
return_values.description: IgnorePublicAcls setting value. Returned: success

return_values.name: RestrictPublicBuckets
return_values.description: RestrictPublicBuckets setting value. Returned: success
